decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed first floor side extension, by means of its size, scale, positioning and design, would complement the side extensions at 23 & 31 Hanover Avenue and would restore symmetry to its associated terraced development, which would improve the appearance of the street scene.  It would not harm the living conditions of adjoining occupants and is therefore in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003 and with the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: The erection of a first floor side extension to the existing dwellinghouse.
